title: No Scent !!
text:
No Scent !!. This candle did NOT have any Scent to it!
I love the Carnation, but I will not be buying the lavender one again.

Its strange , cause some people here said the lavender was too strong!! Go figure!

product_metadata.title: Mrs. Meyer's Soy Aromatherapy Candle, 25 Hour Burn Time, Made with Soy Wax and Essential Oils, Lavender, 4.9 oz
features: This candle is made from plant-derived ingredients like soy wax and vegetable wax and other thoughtfully-chosen ingredients.
Lead-free candle wick burns for 25 hours for a long-lasting Lavender scent
Garden-inspired Lavender scented candle has an original and clean floral scent
Comes in a recyclable glass candle jar - makes for an easy gift
Mrs. Meyer's products are made with cruelty-free formulas and are Leaping Bunny certified.
description: Sometimes it feels good just to have a nice candle giving off some extra fragrance while you're busy with your chores. A Mrs. Meyer's Clean Day Lavender Candle can help you do exactly that. Let the wonderful scent of Lavender fill your room. Lavender has an original and clean floral scent. Such a pretty and reassuring herb! The cute recyclable glass candle jar makes it a great gift idea as well. All candles are made from vegetable, cottonseed and soy wax as well as other thoughtfully chosen ingredients. The lead-free cotton candle wick has a 25-hour burn time and provides garden-inspired fragrance while you clean or relax at home. Also available in other garden-inspired scents and products such as body lotions, laundry detergents, bar soaps, and so much more! Mrs. Meyer's - Rooted in Goodness.
